audience: fleet managers who track vehicles, trackers and trips in Navixy

useCases.title: See which vehicles are moving now
useCases.text: List live asset states filtered by motion or connectivity, then read the position and speed of one asset.

useCases.title: Find devices that went offline
useCases.text: List GPS trackers and sensors filtered by status, then read the live state of one device with its readings.

useCases.title: Review the trips and stops of a vehicle
useCases.text: Read the trips and stops of one asset for a time range, with distances and driving and stop times.

useCases.title: List geofences and asset groups
useCases.text: List geofences, points of interest and routes, and the asset groups used for fleet segmentation.
